summary: A 1981 wire report says a forest fire threatened the Division of Forestry lookout tower at Wekiva; a USGS site record carries its name. No build or current-condition source found.

events.note: Forest fire in Levy County threatened the Division of Forestry lookout tower at Wekiva; volunteers stopped the blaze a few feet from the lookout's state-owned residence.
Report refers to the tower's lookout and to a state-owned home for that lookout.

evidence.supports: fire began on a Sunday afternoon in Levy County and was still out of control the next day
evidence.quote: A fast moving forest fire which began Sunday afternoon in Levy County was still out of control on Monday.

evidence.supports: no private homes reported endangered; Division of Forestry lookout tower at Wekiva threatened
evidence.quote: No private homes were reported endangered by the fire, but a Division of Forestry lookout tower at Wekiva was threatened.

evidence.supports: volunteers stopped the blaze a few feet from the lookout's state-owned residence
evidence.quote: Volunteer firemen stopped the blaze just a few feet away from the state-owned residence of the lookout

evidence.supports: lookout's furniture moved out as a precaution
evidence.quote: Her furniture was moved out as a precaution.

evidence.supports: report is an AP wire story reprinted from the Fort Walton Beach Playground Daily News
evidence.quote: Fort Walton Beach Playground Daily News

evidence.supports: USGS site is named Wekiva Fire Tower, ADC.
evidence.quote: Location name WEKIVA FIRE TOWER, ADC.

sources.title: Wekiva, FOREST LOOKOUTS (AP report reprinted from the Fort Walton Beach Playground Daily News, March 17, 1981)
Wekiva Fire Tower, Adc. (USGS site 291945082384301)
sources.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey, Water Data for the Nation

notes_for_editor: Thin: one 1981 AP clipping transcribed on a hobby site (original newspaper not checked) and a USGS site record with name and coordinates only. The clipping names the lookout; the story omits the name. The lookout page gives no coordinates (only a township and range, 13S-17E-30), so the USGS coordinates are not compared with anything; the story makes no coordinate claim. Cached NHLR and FFLOS pages do not mention Wekiva. Build date, height, current status and access remain unsourced; record left as unknown.
